title.en: Make one first step inspectable
title.zh: 让第一步可以被共同检查

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：聚会安排迟迟未定，一位虚构读者先写下一个可撤回的时间提案，而不是替所有人作决定。其他人可以改动或拒绝；开始一件事也可以是询问谁愿意参与，而不是承担领导身份。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: Plans for a gathering remain undecided. A fictional reader offers one revisable time rather than deciding for everyone. Others can change or decline it. Starting can mean asking who wants to participate, without adopting a leadership identity.

title.en: An optional small experiment
title.zh: 一个可以不做的小尝试

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“哪一步只是提出选择，哪一步才需要其他人同意？”可以只讨论虚构人物。愿意参与的人可不同意或结束；无需解释私人经历，也不用通过实践证明符号适合自己。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “Which step merely offers a choice, and which needs others’ agreement?” Discuss only fictional people. Willing participants may disagree or stop without explaining private experiences or proving the symbol fits through action.

title.en: A shared plan with two different needs
title.zh: 把共同安排中的两种需要说清楚

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：两位虚构室友讨论公共空间。一人复述对方想法后，仍说出自己需要安静的时段。倾听与保留不同意见可以同时存在；暂未达成共识，不说明谁不够体贴。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: Two fictional housemates discuss shared space. One restates the other’s suggestion while retaining a personal need for quiet hours. Listening can coexist with disagreement. An unresolved agreement proves neither person inconsiderate.

title.en: Try asking one clarifying question
title.zh: 可选尝试：先问清一个问题

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“哪些需要可以协商，哪些边界不因照顾关系而消失？”可以只讨论虚构人物。愿意参与的人可不同意或结束；无需解释私人经历，也不用通过实践证明符号适合自己。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “Which needs are negotiable, and which boundaries remain while caring about the relationship?” Discuss only fictional people. Willing participants may disagree or stop without explaining private experiences or proving the symbol fits through action.

title.en: Give a shared memory a small form
title.zh: 给共同回忆一个小小的载体

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者把活动想法写成三句话，先问朋友是否愿意看。朋友更喜欢一张示意图，读者便换一种呈现方式。一次表达的形式与反馈，不衡量创造力，也不要求把个人经历变成可展示的作品。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: A fictional reader writes an activity idea in three sentences and asks whether a friend wants to see it. The friend prefers a sketch, so the format changes. One presentation and its feedback measure no creativity and require no personal story to become a performance.

title.en: Make one low-pressure version
title.zh: 试做一个低压力版本

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“想表达的内容、受众是否愿意参与、呈现形式能否分别讨论？”可以只讨论虚构人物。愿意参与的人可不同意或结束；无需解释私人经历，也不用通过实践证明符号适合自己。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “Can the idea, the audience’s willingness and the presentation format be discussed separately?” Discuss only fictional people. Willing participants may disagree or stop without explaining private experiences or proving the symbol fits through action.

title.en: A small exchange that needs a few clear labels
title.zh: 小型交换活动中的几个清楚标签

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者为周末采购列出短清单，后来发现店铺临时关闭，便调整顺序并删去不必要的项目。框架的用途是减少当下负担；修改计划并不证明不够自律，没按清单行动也不等于失败。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: A fictional reader makes a short shopping list, then changes its order and removes an unnecessary item when a shop closes. A framework can reduce a present burden. Revising a plan proves no lack of discipline, and departing from a list need not mean failure.

title.en: Try a frame with one deliberate open space
title.zh: 尝试留有一处空白的框架

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“这个框架解决什么具体问题，何时值得修改或停用？”可以只讨论虚构人物。愿意参与的人可不同意或结束；无需解释私人经历，也不用通过实践证明符号适合自己。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “What specific problem does the framework solve, and when should it change or stop?” Discuss only fictional people. Willing participants may disagree or stop without explaining private experiences or proving the symbol fits through action.

title.en: Try another format without replacing the whole activity
title.zh: 试一种形式，无需替换整个活动

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者在熟悉的公园里考虑一条新路线，先查看出口和体力需求，也保留原路返回的选择。探索可以很小，也可以不发生；选择熟悉路线不表示不够开放，更不需要冒险来证明某个标签。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: A fictional reader considers a new route in a familiar park, checking exits and effort while retaining a way back. Exploration may be small or declined. Taking the familiar route proves no lack of openness and requires no risk to demonstrate a label.

title.en: Compare one small alternative
title.zh: 比较一个小的替代选项

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“尝试是否自愿，怎样返回，选择不尝试是否同样被尊重？”可以只讨论虚构人物。愿意参与的人可不同意或结束；无需解释私人经历，也不用通过实践证明符号适合自己。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “Is trying voluntary, how can the person return, and is declining equally respected?” Discuss only fictional people. Willing participants may disagree or stop without explaining private experiences or proving the symbol fits through action.

title.en: A shared meal needs more than one kind of help
title.zh: 共同聚餐需要不同形式的帮忙

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者收到朋友请托，先确认对方需要陪伴还是实际帮忙，再说自己只能留十分钟。双方另找后续安排。关心可以有清楚限度，拒绝一项任务也不说明关心更少；帮助者不因此成为长期负责人。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: A fictional reader receives a friend’s request, checks whether company or practical help is wanted, and states a ten-minute limit. They seek another arrangement for later. Care can have limits. Declining a task proves no lesser care and creates no permanent responsibility.

title.en: Make one ordinary responsibility visible
title.zh: 让一项普通责任被看见

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“谁提出了什么请求，谁愿意承担哪一部分，何时结束？”可以只讨论虚构人物。愿意参与的人可不同意或结束；无需解释私人经历，也不用通过实践证明符号适合自己。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “Who requested what, who freely accepts which part, and when does it end?” Discuss only fictional people. Willing participants may disagree or stop without explaining private experiences or proving the symbol fits through action.

title.en: Keep a symbolic story separate from a duty

paragraphs.zh: 补充情境与讨论提示由费马测试编辑部原创。公历日期先按所选规则运算，再查找共用的十二篇故事；它不是人格测量、分数、成熟度、能力或未来预测。分开化简法分别化简月、日、年再相加；整日数字法先加八个日期数字。每次化简遇到一位数或11、22、33就停止，44仍化简为8。两法可能不同：1980-01-01分别为11与2，2009-11-11分别为33与6，1990-09-23分别为6与33。不同来自停止规则，不是双重人格、精度高低或哪个结果更真实；11、22、33不比2、4、6高级。算式可复算不构成故事的科学效度。两条公开来源用于说明各自计算约定，不验证本站原创叙事、双语等价或个人适配。标签相同共用一篇指南，标签不同可分别阅读，不合成新类型或配对建议。故事可觉得不适用，也可只看虚构人物；讨论不需生日、姓名、个人答案或认同任何标签。当前输入与详细算式只在本页内存，修改日期或方法会清除结果；清除、刷新或切换语言后需重新输入。复制只含所选标签与方法，不含生日、算式或个人链接；如希望分享故事，可单独使用无需生日的公开指南。不要发送日期或运算截图来证明讨论结论。
paragraphs.en: FermatMind Editorial authored these additional scenes and prompts. A Gregorian date is processed by the chosen rule, then linked to twelve shared stories. This measures no personality, score, maturity, ability or future. The parts rule reduces month, day and year separately before combining them; the digit rule first adds all eight date digits. Each reduction stops at one digit or 11, 22 or 33; 44 still reduces to 8. Rules can differ: 1980-01-01 gives 11 and 2, 2009-11-11 gives 33 and 6, and 1990-09-23 gives 6 and 33, respectively. Differences follow stopping rules, without two personalities, superior accuracy or a truer result. Eleven, twenty-two and thirty-three rank no higher than two, four and six. Reproducible arithmetic establishes no scientific validity for a story. The two public sources explain calculation conventions, without validating these original narratives, bilingual equivalence or personal fit. Equal labels share a guide; different labels can be read separately without creating another type or compatibility advice. Stories may feel inapplicable. Discuss fictional people without dates, names, personal answers or identifying with a label. Current input and detailed operations stay in page memory; editing the date or method clears results. Clearing, reloading or changing language requires fresh input. Copying includes only the selected label and method, without a date, operations or personal link. A birth-date-free public guide can separately share the story. Do not send dates or calculation screenshots to substantiate a discussion.
